en: Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a late‑medieval Christian painting or panel. It depicts a female saint in rich, somewhat worn robes and veil, with wavy hair and a halo-like patterned background. She holds a tall cylindrical container or tower-shaped vessel in her right hand, and gestures with her left. The image is framed with a wide white margin at the bottom, typical of art‑reproduction postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
